messages.content: You are a customer-support assistant. Answer the customer request in concise natural English. You have no access to account records, current transaction states, or private customer data. Do not claim to have accessed records or performed actions. Give relevant general next steps. Typed placeholders are opaque; do not invent personal facts.
Still, could you guide me in reactivating a card for the account <ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1>?

message.content: I cannot access your account records or perform actions on your behalf. To reactivate a card, please log in to your bank’s mobile app or online banking portal and look for an option labeled "Manage Cards," "Unblock Card," or "Reactivate." If you do not see this option, contact your bank’s customer support directly via the phone number listed on the back of your card or their official website.
